en.name: King
en.ability: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
en.flavor: Betwixt the unknown strains of mortal strife / And morbid night, sweet with mystery and woe / Lies unfettered joys of fate’s long and colored life / Who’s garden blooms with each painted Face to Show.

zh.name: 国王
